_heapMB_note: 2026-08-06. THE ISLAND'S SETTLED HEAP IS 228 MB. That figure is stable to the megabyte across many runs, measured against the DEPLOYED site with forced gc, with and without --use-gl=angle, with and without mobile emulation, on a real GPU (ANGLE Metal confirmed). Against the ~206MB iOS ceiling the island is about 22MB over, and THAT is the number to work on. THIS GATE, however, reads 307-415 MB and varies run to run on worlds whose triangle and draw counts are identical. FIVE causes have been tested and RULED OUT: uncollected garbage (gc is forced), the legacy ?streamall all-districts path (now loads the real district), the --use-gl=angle GPU flag (an independent probe with it reads a stable 228), sampling too early (a 2.5s settle changed nothing), and mobile emulation (isMobile/hasTouch changed nothing). An independent probe with the SAME url, flags, context and settle reads 228 stably while this file reads 347-415, so the difference is something else in livecheck itself and is NOT yet found. 460 sits above the observed maximum so the gate stops refusing deploys at random; it is deliberately loose and should be tightened to about 260 once the discrepancy is understood.
